caseName: Yazoo & Mississippi Valley Railroad v. Board of Mississippi Levee Commissioners
caseNameFull: Yazoo & Mississippi Valley Railroad Co. v. Board of Mississippi Levee Commissioners
attorneys: Messrs. Bich~ ard C. Beckett, V. W. Foster, and E.. C. Craig for appellant. Mr. Pat H. Eager, Jr. for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question. Nashville; C. & St. L. Ry. v. Browning, 310 U. S. 362, 368-369; New York Rapid Transit Co. v. New York. City, 303 U. S. 573, 578-581; Atlantic Coast Line v. Daughton, 262 U. S. 413, 423-424.
